title: Holy Crepes! · French Market crepe cart · New Orleans
description: Bay 23 in the French Market since 2017. Sweet and savory crepes made to order, gluten free and dairy free done properly.
name: Holy Crepes!

hero.kicker: Crepe cart, Bay 23 · 1100 N Peters St, French Market
hero.headline: A crepe cart in the French Market since 2017, folded into a sleeve so you can keep walking.
hero.sub: Sweet on one chalkboard, savory on the other, made to order on a single griddle while you stand there. Gluten free and dairy free are handled properly here rather than grudgingly.

paragraphs: Holy Crepes has been parked at Bay 23 in the French Market since July 2017, which the side of the cart will tell you if you look. It is a cart in the real sense: chalkboards bolted to the front, sweet listed on one and savory on the other, a griddle behind them, and a line that forms and clears in about the time it takes to make four crepes.

Al and Misho run it, and reviewers name them, which almost never happens with a market stall. The Crep Club is the savory one people come back for. There is a Monte Cristo, a Nutella with strawberry and banana, and a frozen basil lemonade that gets mentioned nearly as often as the food. Gluten free and dairy free are not an afterthought either. More than one review is somebody with an allergy writing in relief.

tip.text: Come before noon. The market fills up after lunch and this is a one-griddle operation, so a four-person line is a fifteen-minute wait. Ask about gluten free before you order, not after.

Riverfront streetcar stops at the market, and it is a short walk down from Jackson Square
